Meta.title: 3WEEQ — A world where civilizations are told in scent
Meta.description: An immersive journey through the perfumes of Egypt, Babylon, Greece, and China — one bottle, four civilizations.

About.title: About Aweeq
About.paragraphOne: We consider perfume not through the note alone, but together with its sensory, cultural and commercial dimensions — bringing the depth of story and the craft of the perfumer onto the same ground.
About.paragraphTwo: Distinction often emerges where craft meets timing. We build our work on three principles: mastery, discipline, and trust.

BrandStory.headline: The Beginning. Where the Perfume Was Born
BrandStory.body:
In ancient Egypt, perfume was not a luxury.
It was an offering to the gods, a memory for kings, and one of the secrets of immortality.
From the blue lotus, myrrh, and frankincense,
the Egyptians drew the first scent ever told.
And now, it rests in your hands.

BabylonStory.headline: Where the First Rose Bloomed
BabylonStory.body:
After humanity learned to preserve scent,
Babylon came to teach them how to beautify it.
In the Hanging Gardens, where the sky meets the earth,
the first rose was plucked at dawn,
and the golden threads of saffron were dried under the Babylonian sun.
Here, perfume was not a luxury… it was art.

GreeceStory.headline: Where Perfume Became Wisdom
GreeceStory.body:
From Babylon to Greece,
scent turned into philosophy.
In the white temples beneath the Aegean sky,
flowers were consecrated as gifts to the gods,
and the Greeks composed the first fragrance that told a story.
Here, perfume was not perfume… it was an idea.

ChinaStory.headline: Where Perfume Touched the Sky
ChinaStory.body:
And the scent crossed the Silk Road,
carrying the secrets of the East.
In the houses of tea and incense,
rose mingled with musk and oud,
and China preserved the purest breaths the world had known.
Here, the journey was complete… and kept forever.

extraction.description: We pick the ingredients at dawn, the moment their scent peaks. Blue lotus, myrrh, frankincense — all gathered by hand.

distillation.title: Distillation
distillation.subtitle: Distillation
